dog.description_text:
Meet Jude, a charming little guy with a heart of gold! He's just arrived in the city, but you’d never know it. He’s been impressively calm and relaxed since day one.

Jude loves to snuggle up next to you on the couch, and he’s got a playful streak that’s starting to shine through. He enjoys plenty of attention but is also happy to entertain himself. His foster suspects there’s a little mischief in him, too. So far he’s “borrowed” slippers, a sock, and a washcloth, but he hands them right back. He’s crate-trained and even brings his stuffed animals in with him when he wants some downtime, and he’s doing great with house training.

Jude is a quick learner who’s really responsive to training. He’s already working on “yes,” “touch,” and recall at home, and he’s still polishing his leash manners as he takes in all the sights and smells of his new neighborhood. He’s shown plenty of interest in meeting other dogs and people, and he seems eager to make new friends everywhere he goes.

Registered adopters interested in Jude can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you’re not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
